scope: Local module visibility through own instance and deduplicated direct dependency instances. Stable compiler/CLI consumption and SDK injection remain pending.
goRejectionOracle: The full Go loader confirms rejection. For lookup failures, the helper loads import-free headers to obtain its private feature graph, restores original files, attaches Go-parsed original modules and exact source digests, then calls the owning Go graph resolver for partial lookups and subjects.
budgetCommitBoundary: Caller counters commit only after graph loading and every import resolve successfully; input and visibility errors preserve the original counters.
originalSpans: Verified import tokens provide target byte spans and canonical paths, including 70000-byte comments without rescan. Error owners retain original graph/source bytes and lookup prefix.
